arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Highmark's counsel argued that the Federal Circuit's de novo standard was wrong.
Allcare's counsel argued that the de novo standard is correct for legal questions.
Justices questioned the relationship between claim construction and the standard of review.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The case concerns the standard of review for patent fee awards. Highmark argues for a deferential standard. Allcare argues for a de novo standard.

paragraphs: The Supreme Court heard oral argument in this case on February 26, 2014.

sections.heading: What each side wants
paragraphs: Highmark wants the Supreme Court to apply an abuse of discretion standard to fee awards.
Allcare wants the Supreme Court to apply a de novo standard to fee awards.

sections.heading: What each side says
paragraphs: Highmark argues that prior Supreme Court cases support a deferential standard for similar fee disputes.
Allcare argues that the de novo standard is appropriate because claim construction involves legal questions.

sections.heading: What the justices asked
paragraphs: Justice Alito questioned why the attorneys' fees context is special compared to other legal issues.
Justice Kagan asked how a judge measures the difference between correct and mistaken claim constructions.
